QUOTE: "Compile time. Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the user config and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` to your functions. The header documents this as the path that avoids a runtime pointer." and "Runtime. Set only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never states that the two are mutually exclusive. It only says the macro path avoids a runtime pointer.
